assessments.name: Nmap
assessments.coverage: Multi-address TCP, service banners and TLS; optional installed Nmap service detection
assessments.inputHelp: One hostname or IP and 1 to 32 explicit ports.
assessments.limit: No UDP, NSE, OS fingerprinting or exploit execution.

assessments.name: Wireshark
assessments.coverage: Offline classic PCAP and PCAPNG Ethernet conversation analysis
assessments.inputHelp: Upload classic Ethernet PCAP or PCAPNG with interface declarations and enhanced packet blocks.
assessments.limit: No live capture, full dissectors, reassembly or decryption.

assessments.name: Metasploit Framework
assessments.coverage: Service-correlated vulnerability triage with validated advisory references
assessments.inputHelp: MetasploitV5 XML evidence file, without a live target.
assessments.limit: Imported candidates require independent verification; no exploit, payload or session execution.

assessments.name: Aircrack-ng
assessments.coverage: Offline 802.11/radiotap beacon security and management-event analysis
assessments.inputHelp: Upload Airodump CSV or classic wireless PCAP, without a live target.
assessments.limit: No radio capture, injection, deauthentication generation, cracking or WPA3 enforcement proof.

assessments.name: Hashcat
assessments.coverage: Bounded offline verification of supplied password candidates against unsalted digests
assessments.inputHelp: JSON: {"algorithm":"sha256","hashes":["hex digest"],"candidates":["local candidate"]}. SHA-384/512 also supported; no live target.
assessments.limit: At most256 hashes,4096 candidates,1million combinations. No Hashcat engine or salted formats; secrets are omitted from reports.

assessments.name: Skipfish
assessments.coverage: Bounded same-origin crawling and per-page HTTP/browser configuration review
assessments.inputHelp: Root HTTP or HTTPS page; visits up to8 pages at depth2, without queries or form submission.
assessments.limit: No JavaScript execution, authenticated flows, injection probes or Skipfish engine.

assessments.name: Foremost
assessments.coverage: Structurally checked PNG, GIF, BMP and WAV byte-range recovery
assessments.inputHelp: Upload bytes containing embedded images/audio. Leave the live target empty.
assessments.limit: 32 artifact maximum; no decompression, disk/deleted-block recovery or full file decoder.

assessments.name: sqlmap
assessments.coverage: Database error disclosure and captured request/error correlation
assessments.inputHelp: One target URL for a baseline GET, or a HAR file with response content.
assessments.limit: No injection probes, SQLMap engine, database extraction or database permission audit.

assessments.name: hping3
assessments.coverage: Repeated TCP connect stability measurements and latency statistics
assessments.inputHelp: One hostname or IP, at most8 explicit ports;3 fixed samples per port.
assessments.limit: No raw packets, spoofing, floods, application payloads or hping engine.

assessments.name: Shodan
assessments.coverage: Indexed service exposure, CVE assertion, freshness and TLS expiry triage
assessments.inputHelp: Shodan host/search/service JSON or JSONL. Optional target is one exact IP filter.
assessments.limit: Offline index evidence only; no live Shodan API, fresh collection or independent vulnerability verification.

assessments.name: Spiderdomain, unresolved name
assessments.coverage: DNS alias/PTR enrichment and offline DNS zone inventory review
assessments.inputHelp: One ASCII domain, or JSON {"origin":"example.test","complete":true,"records":[{"name":"@","type":"TXT","value":"v=spf1 -all"}]}. Absolute DNS names end in a dot.
assessments.limit: Upstream identity unresolved. No takeover proof, zone transfer, DNSSEC or exhaustive discovery.

assessments.name: Maltego
assessments.coverage: Cross-report entity correlation, directed paths and relationship provenance
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"reports":[normalized report objects],"from":"optional node label","to":"optional node label"}. Leave target empty.
assessments.limit: 20 reports and1000 combined nodes/edges; exact entity matches only. No commercial transforms or external collection.

assessments.name: Airgorah
assessments.coverage: Wireless snapshot comparison for protection downgrades and AP metadata changes
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"before":"Airodump AP CSV text","after":"Airodump AP CSV text"}; leave target empty.
assessments.limit: 1000 records per snapshot. Offline evidence only; no radio operations or impersonation proof.

assessments.name: Netcat
assessments.coverage: Fixed read-only service protocol probes and bounded response confirmation
assessments.inputHelp: One hostname/IP and1 to8 ports. Known ports use HTTP HEAD, SMTP EHLO, Redis PING or Memcached version; others read banners.
assessments.limit: No arbitrary payloads, shell, listeners, relay, TLS negotiation or netcat engine.

assessments.name: Passive reconnaissance
assessments.coverage: Scoped CT evidence, native DNS and verified public TLS SAN collection
assessments.inputHelp: One authorized ASCII/punycode domain. Optional crt.sh-style JSON array makes the assessment offline.
assessments.limit: No CT API query, brute-force, discovered-host requests or complete asset inventory. Historical names do not prove live services.

assessments.name: SpiderFoot
assessments.coverage: Scoped infrastructure event correlation, provenance and exposure review
assessments.inputHelp: Required target domain plus official SpiderFoot JSON event array or Type/Data CSV.
assessments.limit: 1000 imported events. No module execution, personal profiling, independent-source proof or fresh collection.

assessments.name: Sherlock
assessments.coverage: Explicit profile-response evidence quality and consistency review
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"username":"test","profiles":[{"url":"https://example.test/test","status":200,"title":"optional","canonical":"optional HTTPS URL","observedAt":"RFC3339"}]}; no live target.
assessments.limit: 32 supplied profiles only. No live enumeration, identity inference or account-existence claims; report values are withheld.

assessments.name: recon-ng
assessments.coverage: Before/after infrastructure inventory reconciliation and source-set comparison
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"domain":"example.test","before":[{"host":"a.example.test","ip_address":"192.0.2.1","source":"cmdb"}],"after":[]}.
assessments.limit: 1000 combined records; offline snapshots only. Absence is not proof of decommissioning or takeover.

assessments.name: BBOT
assessments.coverage: Scoped recursive-scan evidence graph, parent provenance and coverage frontier
assessments.inputHelp: Required target domain plus BBOT infrastructure JSON or JSONL events.
assessments.limit: 1000 supplied events. No live recursive scanning, off-scope collection or ownership proof.

assessments.name: CloudFox
assessments.coverage: CloudFormation S3, RDS, security-group and IAM configuration checks
assessments.inputHelp: AWS CloudFormation JSON with Resources, or an IAM Statement policy. Leave target empty.
assessments.limit: Selected static checks only; unresolved intrinsic expressions are unknown. No deployed inventory or effective-permission simulation.

assessments.name: Evilginx3
assessments.coverage: Defensive session-cookie, transport, caching, framing and password-form review
assessments.inputHelp: One authorized URL for a baseline GET, or a HAR with response headers and optional HTML content.
assessments.limit: Defensive assessment only. No phishing proxy, interception, credential collection or MFA bypass; authentication design still needs authenticated review.

assessments.name: Caido
assessments.coverage: Paired HAR comparison and owner-defined expected-denial evidence review
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"baseline":HAR,"candidate":HAR,"expectDenied":["/optional-path"]}. Optional target scopes one origin.
assessments.limit: Offline unambiguous endpoint comparisons only; no interception, replay or confirmed authorization-bypass claims.

assessments.name: Nuclei
assessments.coverage: Native HTTP exposure rules for directory listings, debug pages, embedded source maps and cookie configuration
assessments.inputHelp: Explicit HTTP or HTTPS page to assess.
assessments.limit: Native rules only; no external template pack or Nuclei engine.

assessments.name: BloodHound
assessments.coverage: Cross-collection directed directory-control path analysis
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"collections":[BloodHound v5/v6 objects],"start":"exact ObjectIdentifier","end":"exact ObjectIdentifier"}; no live target.
assessments.limit: 20 collections and1000 combined records. Selected membership/ACL paths only; no collector, exploit execution or effective-access proof.

assessments.name: CyberChef
assessments.coverage: JWT policy/lifetime and public-certificate security review
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"kind":"jwt","value":"token","expectedIssuer":"optional","expectedAudience":"optional"} or {"kind":"pem","value":"public certificate PEM"}.
assessments.limit: 256 KiB and32 certificates; no private keys, JWT signature verification, certificate trust verification or full CyberChef engine.

assessments.name: Burp Suite
assessments.coverage: Captured API method/path, response, query-parameter and media-type contract checks
assessments.inputHelp: JSON {"spec":OpenAPI3 document,"har":HAR1.2 document}. Optional target scopes one origin.
assessments.limit: 1000 operations/entries; offline declared contracts only. No Burp engine, interception, replay or authenticated behavioral testing.
